metaDescription: How to use P.L.A.W: from sign-up through planning and logging practices to analytics.
title: How to use P.L.A.W
subtitle: From sign-up to analytics — everything you need, step by step.

steps.title: Create your account
steps.body: Sign up as a coach and log in. Registration is free for now.

steps.title: Add your player
steps.body: P.L.A.W always works with one active player. Add them in the Players section — you can switch to another one anytime.

steps.title: Set up your drill codes
steps.body: The heart of the whole app. For each focus you get 20 slots to rename into your own drill shortcuts. Your analytics later break down exactly by these, so set them up first.

steps.title: Plan a practice
steps.body: Create a practice with a date, time and duration. If your Google Calendar is connected, the event is added there automatically.

steps.title: Log what happened
steps.body: Add drills to the practice — focus, shot character, code and duration. You can reorder them with arrows while the practice is still planned.

steps.title: Review and lock
steps.body: After the practice, fill in the actual time and notes, and mark drills as not played or replaced. Lock a finished practice — it becomes a permanent record.

steps.title: Track your analytics
steps.body: Overviews by week, month, quarter and year, compared to last season. Broken down by drill code and shot character.

steps.title: Share with player, parent or manager
steps.body: Generate an access code and send it. The player, parent or manager gets their own view of the practice history — read-only.

tips: Add the app to your phone's home screen and use it like a native app right on the court.
Inactive players live in the archive — their full history stays available, read-only.
The app works in Slovak and English and always shows time in your own time zone.
ctaText: Create an account in a few minutes and plan your first practice today.
